shared_elements: single large standing human figure filling the field of an upright slab
low-relief carving with figure shown in near-profile/frontal-torso posture
figure apparently holding/gripping objects at chest and side
dense secondary ornament filling the space around the figure
band of smaller repeated motifs along the lower edge
justification: Both show a single dominant standing figure with an elaborate headdress occupying nearly the whole upright slab, holding objects, with the surrounding field filled by dense small ornament and a register of smaller repeated motifs at the base  iggest differences are that B's figure is a bird-headed winged being with naturalistically modelled musculature, feathering and rosette filler, while A's figure is wingless, blockier and schematic with its surrounding filler reading as panel/sign-like elements rather than floral rosettes. The correspondence is at the level of general composition (one big standing figure, filler ornament, basal register) rather than of any distinctive shared motif.
